---- Respondent For Applicant : Mr. Vinay Pandey, Advocate.

For Respondent. : Mr. Sushil Sahu, P.L.
 For Objector : Mr. Siddharth Dubey, Advocate  Hon'ble Smt. Justice Rajani Dubey  Order on Board 19/01/2023  Heard  Admit 1.

This application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.612/2022 registered at Police Station - Basna, District Mahasamund (C.G.) for commission of the offence punishable under Sections 376 (2) (n) of Indian Penal Code and Sections 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Allegation against the present applicant is that he committed forcible sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix on the pretext of married, later he denied to marry the prosecutrix.
Based on this, the offence has been registered.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the father of the prosecutrix had borrowed Hemant Kumar Chaudhary vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7994444/
1 Rs.70,000/- from the applicant and when the applicant demanded his money, the false FIR came to be lodged.

entities.text: Hemant Kumar Chaudhary vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that there is unexplained inordinate delay in lodging the FIR & that too has been lodged after marriage of the prosecutrix, which clearly shows ill intent of the prosecutrix.
Thus, considering the aforesaid factual aspect of the matter, the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the anticipatory bail application.

5. Learned counsel for the objector vehemently opposing the bail application submits that though there was cordial relation between the applicant and prosecutrix but the applicant cannot take disadvantage of that relation.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having considered the material on record and further considering the fact that delayed FIR has been lodged that too after marriage of the prosecutrix, without further commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
7. Accordingly, the application is allowed.

Sd/-
 (Rajani Dubey)
